title: Joint scalar Hom presentations normalized before completion
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,L/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a coefficient embedding $\iota:E\to L$, and a scheme $X$. Use completed coefficient sheaves and scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], the ambient internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], and the ordinary scalar tensorator and completion transformation [def-pod-scalar-completion-tensor-comparisons]. There are source and target IntegralHom.TensorPresentations $a,b$ [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models] and a natural isomorphism $e$ from pbcDerivedExtend(completedCoefficientMap $\iota$) to integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar $\iota$. For every ambient $K,M$, the ordinary presentation homMap, followed by internal Hom of $e_K^{-1}$ contravariantly and $e_M$ covariantly, equals $e_{H(K,M)}$ followed by scalarHomOrdinary. For every ambient $K$, completedScalarComparison at $K$ equals $e_K$ followed by scalarCompletion at $K$. This statement imposes neither constructibility nor derived completeness and asserts no completed Hom isomorphism.

source.place: Proof sentence: The general Hom comparisons are defined by the same evaluation maps.

proof.text: The completed coefficient ring maps agree on all finite projections. The two ordinary scalar functors therefore have the same balanced tensor model. Universal left-derived comparison gives e, normalized by the ordinary tensor units.

Choose both TensorPresentations jointly from the fixed closed adjunctions, transported by Koszul symmetry on every ambient input. The ordinary tensor comparison agrees on pure tensors; sheafification and K-flat descent preserve this square. Its transpose is the asserted ordinary Hom equation, with e inverse on the contravariant argument.

The two completion maps have the same finite-quotient components x maps to 1 tensor x and zero shifted Roos coordinate. Equality of both coordinate projections identifies their representative cocone maps. Uniqueness of normalized localization descent then gives completedScalarComparison = e followed by scalarCompletion, before restricting to complete inputs.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarHom_presentation_evaluation
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) L] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[Padic l] L) :
    ∃ (a : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X))
      (b : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L X))
      (e : pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E L ι X) ≅
        integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l E L ι X),
      (∀ K M : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X),
        IntegralFiniteExtension.homMap X (completedCoefficientMap l E L ι X) a b K M ≫
            (coefficientIntegralInternalHom l L X).map
              (Prod.mkHom (e.inv.app K).op (e.hom.app M)) =
          e.hom.app ((coefficientIntegralInternalHom l E X).obj (op K, M)) ≫
            scalarHomOrdinary l E L ι X K M) ∧
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X),
        (completedScalarComparison l E L ι X).app K =
          e.hom.app K ≫ (scalarCompletion l E L ι X).app K
